translations.web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
translations.bsb: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
translations.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
translations.asv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
